translations.literal: Divided in four sections: first Jingyun dance, second Celebrating Goodness, third Breaks the Array, fourth Receiving Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Four sections: Jingyun, Celebrating Goodness, Breaks the Array, Receiving Heaven dances.

sentences.zh: 景雲樂，舞八人，五色雲冠，錦袍，五色袴，金銅帶。

translations.literal: Jingyun music: eight dancers, five-colored cloud caps, brocade robes, five-colored trousers, bronze-gold belts.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyun: eight dancers in five-color cloud caps, brocade robes and trousers, gilt belts.

sentences.zh: 慶善樂，舞四人，紫袍，白袴。

translations.literal: Celebrating Goodness: four dancers, purple robes, white trousers.
translations.idiomatic: Celebrating Goodness: four in purple robes, white trousers.

sentences.zh: 破陣樂，舞四人，綾袍，絳袴。

translations.literal: Breaks the Array: four dancers, damask robes, crimson trousers.
translations.idiomatic: Breaks the Array: four in damask robes, crimson trousers.

sentences.zh: 承天樂，舞四人，進德冠，紫袍，白袴。

translations.literal: Receiving Heaven: four dancers, jinde caps, purple robes, white trousers.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving Heaven: four in jinde caps, purple robes, white trousers.

sentences.zh: 景雲舞，元會第一奏之。

translations.literal: Jingyun dance was performed first at the New Year assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyun dance opened the New Year assembly.

sentences.zh: 高宗以琴曲寖絕，雖有傳者，復失宮商，令有司脩習。

translations.literal: Gaozong held qin pieces were gradually lost; though some were transmitted they again lost gong and shang; he ordered the authorities to repair and practice.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong found qin repertoire fading; surviving pieces had lost proper modes—he ordered restoration.

sentences.zh: 太常丞呂才上言：「舜彈五絃之琴，歌南風之詩，是知琴操曲弄皆合於歌。

translations.idiomatic: Assistant Director Lü Cai argued: "Shun's five-string qin and Southern Winds show melodies must match lyrics."

sentences.zh: 今以御雪詩為白雪歌。

translations.literal: Now take the Imperial Snow poem as White Snow song.
translations.idiomatic: He set the Imperial Snow poem as White Snow song.

translations.literal: Ancient and modern in performing proper pieces there is also sending voice—the lord sings and ministers harmonize; take the ministers' harmonizing poem of sixteen rhymes as sending voice in sixteen sections.
translations.idiomatic: Proper pieces include "sending voice"—lord sings, ministers answer; sixteen rhymes of minister poetry became sixteen sending sections.

sentences.zh: 」帝善之，乃命太常著于樂府。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved and ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to record it in the Music Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved; the Court entered it in the Music Bureau.

sentences.zh: 才復撰琴歌、白雪等曲，帝亦製歌詞十六，皆著樂府。

translations.idiomatic: Cai composed qin songs including White Snow; the emperor added sixteen lyrics—all filed in the Music Bureau.

sentences.zh: 帝將伐高麗，燕洛陽城門，觀屯營教舞，按新征用武之勢，名曰一戎大定樂，舞者百四十人，被五采甲，持槊而舞，歌者和之曰：「八紘同軌樂。

translations.literal: The emperor was about to campaign Goryeo and feasted at Luoyang city gate, viewing encampment drill dance; following the new expedition's martial bearing he titled it One Military Great Settlement Music—140 dancers in five-colored armor dancing with spears; singers harmonized: "Eight Directions Same Track Music.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Goryeo campaign he feasted at Luoyang's gate, watching drill dances; he named One Military Great Settlement Music—140 armored dancers with spears; the chorus sang Eight Directions Same Track Music.

sentences.zh: 」象高麗平而天下大定也。

translations.literal: " Imaging Goryeo pacified and the realm greatly settled.
translations.idiomatic: It imaged Goryeo subdued and the realm settled.

sentences.zh: 及遼東平，行軍大總管李勣作夷美賓之曲以獻。

translations.literal: When Liaodong was pacified Campaign Commander Li Ji composed the Yimei Guest piece and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: After Liaodong fell, Li Ji presented the Yimei Guest piece.

sentences.zh: 調露二年，幸洛陽城南樓，宴羣臣，太常奏六合還淳之舞，其容制不傳。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiaolu, visiting the south tower of Luoyang, feasting ministers, the Court performed the Six Harmonies Return to Purity dance; its form is not transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tiaolu year 2, at Luoyang's south tower feast, the Court played Six Harmonies Return to Purity—its choreography unrecorded.

sentences.zh: 高宗自以李氏老子之後也，於是命樂工製道調。

translations.literal: Gaozong held himself descendant of the Li clan and Laozi and therefore ordered musicians to compose Dao mode.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong, claiming descent from Laozi, ordered musicians to compose Dao mode.
